source_row.stem: A nurse counsels a client in the third trimester of pregnancy to avoid NSAIDs because of the risk of:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"No relevant risk in the third trimester","B":"Improved fetal lung development","C":"Only maternal gastrointestinal upset","D":"Premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus"}}
source_row.rationale: NSAID use in the third trimester of pregnancy carries a risk of premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus, a serious complication, leading to FDA guidance generally advising against use after 20 weeks gestation.
source_row.source_name: FDA Drug Safety Communication — NSAIDs in Pregnancy
